facts.fact: Vanguard reports Nigeria holds its voters' register in biometric registration and electronic databases, and an INEC source says the commission has carried out three phases of continuous voter registration.
An INEC source tells Vanguard the register was displayed at wards and online, and that hundreds of thousands of claims and objections have been received.
